world.title: Ben Shelton rolls past Frances Tiafoe to reach US Open final
world.description: The Americans have their representative for the U.S. Open men's singles final. Now, it'll be up to Ben Shelton to see if he can break the Americans' 23-year Grand Slam drought. Shelton beat Frances Tiafoe 4-6, 6-3, 6-3, 7-5 to reach the final and get a chance at No. 1 seed Alexander Zverev.

world.title: Global funds sour on India stocks as some cut allocation to zero
world.description: Global investors are reducing Indian equity exposure due to a lack of AI investment themes. Foreign portfolio ownership has fallen to a seventeen-year low as funds exit the market. India now ranks as the least-favored market in Asia according to a recent survey. Local institutions are providing support, but foreign capital remains a concern. Investors seek more durable foreign direct investments to fuel manufacturing ambitions.
